episodes.title: Spac Nation Is A Cult - Leave Us Alone!   UK Youths Calls Out Pastor Tobi
episodes.description:
A UK-based lady has raised concerns after alleging that members of Pastor Tobi Adegboyega’s SPAC Nation repeatedly contacted and attempted to lure her into joining the church.

She claimed prospective members are invited to networking events without initially being told the event is connected to SPAC Nation and are offered incentives such as £50 Amazon vouchers.
